policy_digest_authority: raw SHA-256 of this policy declaration; separate from the descriptor-specific native controller profile digest
ownership_meaning: The canonical ownership enum uses stance for a non-recovery joint-motor controller. The separately retained walking_controller_policy_id identifies this development walking policy; it is never labeled BW5R-B.
rule: Select only for a fresh resumed-walking session in a separately bound development candidate. Preserve prefix BW5R-B, recovery V20, stance V7, model, input translation, motor limits, solver, and all criteria. Native profile differs from BW5R-B only in schema, policy ID and scheduled swing-end recontact mode. This declaration alone authorizes no run.
